title: fix(url): base createURL on UiState instead of SearchParameters
body:
**Summary**

This allows the URL to make sense (be filled) before the widget is mounted (like in React InstantSearch Hooks for the initial render)

**Result**

FX-2416: overall task
FX-2438: setup to allow createURL to use UiState, ensuring routing uses UiState on initial mount
FX-2439: refinementList
FX-2440: pagination
FX-2441: breadcrumb
FX-2442: clearRefinements (skipped)
FX-2443: currentRefinements (skipped)
FX-2444: hierarchicalMenu
FX-2445: hitsPerPage
FX-2446: menu
FX-2447: numericMenu
FX-2448: ratingMenu
FX-2449: toggleRefinement
FX-2450: tests

Both clearRefinements and currentRefinements have not been solved as it would require the whole widget to work with uiState instead of helper state (which it currently does). This should be done at a later stage, as it's unlikely to be fixable without translating manually between every possible widget's ui state and search state.

fixes #5236
